# Task 3 "Frame parser": BLOCKED, routed to a granted amendment

## Classification (primary, from structured output only)

Task 3 returned a structured `BLOCKED` result with this quoted evidence:

- `src/frame.ts:18 - if (kind === HEARTBEAT) return true`
- assertion: `expected heartbeat allowed, got rejected`

The proposed change edits the text of one approved **drafted** AC row. That edit is backed by quoted implementer evidence, so it is an **amend item**, not a redraw:

- No row is added or removed.
- No ticket row is involved.
- The problem statement is unchanged.
- No component or boundary changes.

The amendment route runs before any other routing. Task 3 stays `in_progress`.

Transcript line (paths are placeholders for observed values; no patch is invented):

```
wave <w> task 3 status BLOCKED report <REPORT_DIR>/wave<w>-task3.md patch <observed Artifacts patch path | none observed>
```

## 1. Prepare the amendment (writes nothing)

```ts
subagent({ async: false, context: "fresh", cwd: "<abs worktree path>",
  chain: [{ parallel: [
    { agent: "plan-writer",
      output: "<REPORT_DIR>/wave<w>-amend-prepare.md", outputMode: "file-only",
      outputSchema: PREPARE_SCHEMA,
      task: "Amend-prepare: Do not edit any file. Worktree: <abs worktree path>; Spec: <abs home spec>; Plan: <abs plan>; Plan skill: <abs skills/writing-plans/SKILL.md>; Plan contract: <abs plan contract>; Surface: <abs skills/brainstorming/reference/amendment-surface.md>. Evidence (Task 3 BLOCKED): `src/frame.ts:18 - if (kind === HEARTBEAT) return true`; assertion `expected heartbeat allowed, got rejected`. Candidate: correct the drafted AC row 'Reject all empty frames' to 'Reject empty payload frames; permit the existing heartbeat marker'. Return items and redraws arrays (both required, even empty); one-paragraph edits." }
  ], stopOn: { path: "/status", in: ["BLOCKED"] } }]
})
```

From the structured JSON I check `redraws` first and never open the report. The scenario says this is a single in-row correction, so I expect `redraws: []` and one item with `recommended: "accept"`. A nonempty `redraws` array would hold the whole batch before any grant evaluation.

## 2. Delegate the grant read

```ts
subagent({ async: false, context: "fresh", cwd: "<abs worktree path>",
  chain: [{ parallel: [
    { output: "<REPORT_DIR>/wave<w>-grant.md", outputMode: "file-only", outputSchema: ANSWER_SCHEMA,
      task: "Read the **Amend-grant:** line(s) in the header block (H1 to first ##) of <abs home spec>. Apply the amendment-surface predicate and Value decoding: report missing/none/active/malformed, amend permission yes/no, and any funded-round token. Quote the line as evidence." }
  ], stopOn: { path: "/status", in: ["BLOCKED"] } }]
})
```

The observed value is `**Amend-grant:** auto-apply amends`. That is one well-formed line with no budget token, so amend permission is active. Under that grant there is no reviewer, menu or confirmation turn.

## 3. Apply the recommended choice

Collect the in-flight paths:

```bash
git -C "<abs worktree path>" status --porcelain
```

Then dispatch the apply:

```ts
subagent({ async: false, context: "fresh", cwd: "<abs worktree path>",
  chain: [{ parallel: [
    { agent: "plan-writer",
      output: "<REPORT_DIR>/wave<w>-amend-apply.md", outputMode: "file-only",
      outputSchema: APPLY_SCHEMA,
      task: "Amend-apply: granted item (recommended: accept), location: <drafted AC section>: 'Reject all empty frames' -> 'Reject empty payload frames; permit the existing heartbeat marker'. Evidence: `src/frame.ts:18 - if (kind === HEARTBEAT) return true`; `expected heartbeat allowed, got rejected`. Amend: <AC section>; preserve every unaffected task title and wave position; edit only affected anchors/tasks. Record original task numbers, titles, spec anchors and wave positions in this report before applying. In-flight: <paths from status --porcelain, incl. spec and any staged in-place repair deliverables>. Paths: worktree, spec, plan, plan skill, plan contract (absolute). Preserve Baseline ownership, protected-path and dirty-baseline exits." }
  ], stopOn: { path: "/status", in: ["BLOCKED"] } }]
})
```

The observed result is `passed: true`. I would only retry once with `failLines` and `previousApplyReport` if it had failed.

## 4. Parent check, tracker and audit commit

1. Run `plan_check({ planPath: "<abs plan>" })`. It is observed as PASS, so I replace the manifest.
2. Update the tracker using only the returned arrays (their contents are not observed here, so none are assumed):
   - `plan_tracker add` for each entry in `tasksAdded`.
   - `update` to `in_progress` for each completed entry in `tasksAnchorChanged`.
   - Use the surface's removal path for `tasksRemoved`.
   - Task 3 remains `in_progress`.
3. Print:
   ```
   amended the spec: Heartbeat frames allowed - the drafted AC row now rejects empty payload frames and permits the existing heartbeat marker
   ```
4. Make the single granted audit commit:
   ```bash
   git -C "<abs worktree path>" add -- "<spec path>" "<plan path>"
   printf '%s\n' \
   'amend: 1 item(s) - Heartbeat frames allowed' \
   '' \
   '- heartbeat | Heartbeat frames allowed | the drafted AC row now rejects empty payload frames and permits the existing heartbeat marker | granted | not reviewed - standing grant | Task 3 BLOCKED: `src/frame.ts:18 - if (kind === HEARTBEAT) return true`; assertion `expected heartbeat allowed, got rejected`' \
   '"auto-apply amends"' \
   | git -C "<abs worktree path>" commit -q -F - -- "<spec path>" "<plan path>"
   ```

**Stop boundary.** I stop here, at the granted `amend:` commit. The next step would be a one-step re-dispatch of Task 3 against the amended anchor. It is not issued and no result is assumed.

## Negative controls (each replaces the setup independently)

None of these auto-apply. In each case the item is classified as a redraw when the batch is prepared, before any grant is evaluated. The `redraws` array is nonempty, so the whole batch is held and any amend siblings wait for re-batching. I stop and take the redraw path:

1. Clear the plan tracker.
2. Reset phases and start `brainstorm`.
3. Delete the plan and the ledger.
4. Resume brainstorming at step 4 with the approved spec as the draft.
5. Ratify at the full gate.

The `auto-apply amends` grant never satisfies the redraw or the spec gate.

| Control | Classification | Auto-apply under grant? |
|---|---|---|
| Row originates in the ticket | Ticket row: redraw | No, stop |
| Only reviewer taste supports it, no implementer evidence | Reviewer-only or taste objection: redraw | No, stop |
| Add or remove a row | Row add/remove: redraw | No, stop |
| Change the problem statement | Problem change: redraw | No, stop |
| Add a component or alter a boundary | Component boundary change: redraw | No, stop |
